title: Theory of the reverse saturable absorption in Ti 3 C 2 T  x   MXene with different surface functionalization groups
content: Recent experimental studies have revealed reverse saturable absorption in Ti3C2Tx MXene at various laser wavelengths. The increase in nonlinear absorption following saturation of the one-photon interband transitions has been attributed to either excited-state absorption or two-photon absorption. In this paper, we develop a theoretical approach for interpreting reverse saturable absorption based on the MXene band structure. We treat both mechanisms, excited-state absorption and two-photon absorption, jointly in the propagation equation, allowing us to consistently include the intensity dependence of nonlinear absorption. The analysis shows that surface terminations play a decisive role in the nonlinear optical response of MXenes, consistent with experimental observations.
